identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of an Investigational Medication for the Treatment of Secondary Hyperparathyroidism in Patients on Dialysis
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Placebo-controlled, Double-blind, Multicenter Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of an Oral Calcimimetic Agent (AMG 073) in Secondary Hyperparathyroidism of Chronic Kidney Disease (Hemodialysis and Peritoneal Dialysis)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This 6 month study will assess an investigational medication for patients on dialysis with secondary hyperparathyroidism. The study will look at the effects on parathyroid hormone, calcium and phosphorus levels.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: 30 mg of placebo taken once daily orally 60 mg of placebo taken once daily orally 90 mg of placebo taken once daily orally 120 mg of placebo taken once daily orally 180 mg of placebo taken once daily orally

interventions.name: AMG 073
interventions.description: 30 mg of AMG 073 taken once daily orally 60 mg of AMG 073 taken once daily orally 90 mg of AMG 073 taken once daily orally 120 mg of AMG 073 taken once daily orally 180 mg of AMG 073 taken once daily orally

primaryOutcomes.measure: To evaluate the efficacy of AMG 073 compared with placebo by determining the proportion of subjects with a mean intact parathyroid hormone (iPTH) value <= 250 pg/mL (26.5 pmol/L) during the efficacy assessment phase.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Efficacy Assessment phase - final 10 weeks of study

secondaryOutcomes.measure: To evaluate the efficacy of AMG 073 compared with placebo by determining: the proportion of subjects with a reduction from baseline in mean iPTH of >= 30% during the efficacy assessment phase
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Efficacy Assessment phase - final 10 weeks of study

secondaryOutcomes.measure: To evaluate the efficacy of AMG 073 compared with placebo by determining: percentage change from baseline in iPTH during the efficacy assessment phase
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Efficacy Assessment phase - final 10 weeks of study

secondaryOutcomes.measure: To evaluate the safety of AMG 073 compared with placebo

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria: Patients must be receiving hemodialysis; have elevated parathyroid hormone levels; not be pregnant or nursing; and not have had a heart attack in the last 3 months.
